defs.def: a weapon that is used for firing bullets or shells 枪；炮

ex.s: Monsieur Loisel reluctantly agrees to pay for a gown costing four hundred francs, knowing he will not be able to afford the hunting gun he had been saving up to buy.
ex.t: 卢瓦泽尔先生勉强同意花四百法郎买礼服，他知道自己将买不起他一直攒钱想买的那支猎枪了。

ex.s: On one occasion, I saved a girl from drowning in a river, but when her friend saw me he fired a gun at me.
ex.t: 有一次，我从河里救了一个溺水的女孩，但她的朋友看到我时却朝我开了一枪。

ex.s: World War Ⅰ had broken out months before, but British and German soldiers out down their guns and played football together - one moment of peace to remember during years of conflict.
ex.t: 第一次世界大战几个月前就爆发了，但英国和德国士兵放下枪，一起踢足球--在多年的冲突中，这是一个值得记住的和平时刻。

defs.def: a tool that uses pressure to send out a substance or an object 喷射器；喷枪
the signal to begin a race, that is made by firing a special gun, called a starting pistol, into the air 起跑信号；发令枪声

ex.s: Jeff had   54   in lowa before Thanksgiving with his dog, Rosie, but the gun shots had scared the dog off.
ex.t: 杰夫在感恩节前带着他的狗Rosie在Lowa有54岁，但枪声把狗吓跑了。

ex.s: That said, with a bang of the starting gun, I would dive into the cold water with all my strength and swim to the other side of the pool as fast as I could, only to find that the other swimmers slid past me.
ex.t: 话虽如此，随着发令枪响，我会全力扎进冷水中，尽可能快地游向泳池另一边，却发现其他游泳者从我身边滑过。
